<meta property="og:description" content="You want an unforgetable holiday with friends , family or your kitemates or even alone? Let us take you on an unforgetable island experience. You choose the date and we set you up with our local islander crew to set off on an adventure of a lifetime hunting the wind and kiting remote islands, deserted beaches, lagoons and sandbars in an idyllic tropical setting. Exact accommodation will vary from night to night, depending on where the tour takes you in tents or bamboo huts on the beach."/>

        <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column last" style="width: 49%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-1816346218"><div id="cc-m-7235783618" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    You want an unforgetable holiday with friends , family or your kitemates or even alone? Let us take you on an unforgetable island experience.  You choose the date and we set you up with our
    local islander crew to set off on an adventure of a lifetime hunting the wind and kiting remote islands, deserted beaches, lagoons and sandbars in an idyllic tropical setting.<br/>
    Exact accommodation will vary from night to night, depending on where the tour takes you in tents or bamboo huts  on the beach.
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7235783518" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 20px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7215919818" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    This tour is the right one if you want to kite every day another spot, if you are an experienced kiter or wingfoiler- that is not scared to travel to open sea.
</p>

<p>
    <strong>You need to have your own gear for this trip and must  be on a level, where you are able to kite without problems upwind, downwind and able to do a selfrescue in deep water.</strong>
</p>

<p>
    Islands we go to on the safari: Buyayao, Suguicay, Libagao, Nagubat, Semirara, Aslom, Target, Sibolo.
</p>

<p>
     
</p>

<p>
    Included in the trip: Guide, Boat, Accomodation , Food and Drinks, Snorkeling, loads of contact to locals, desert island experiences, campfires at night, climb coconut trees and catch your fish
</p>

<p>
    <strong>Price per person: 19900 PHP minimum 2 people</strong>
</p>

<p>
     
</p>

<p>
      <span style="font-size: 12px;">*Beginners we recommend to use Bislig beach as a base and to go on <a href="/watersports/daytrip/" title="Daytrip">daytrips</a> to the islands from
    there.</span>
</p></div></div>    </div>
